title: My 81-year-old neighbor put up a camera to catch whoever was "stealing" his snow
note: Original story (fiction), written for Snowplow Rush. Wholesome twist; suburbs footage.
lines: My eighty-one year old neighbor put up a camera to catch whoever was stealing his snow.
Gary hates everyone on our street. Especially me, because my snowblower is loud.
Last winter we got buried. Three feet in two days.
So every morning at five, before he woke up, I cleared his driveway. Then mine.
By day three, Gary was telling the whole street someone was messing with his property.
By day four, there was a camera on his garage.
On day five, he knocked on my door.
I was ready for a fight.
Instead, he handed me a tin of cookies.
He said his wife used to clear that driveway. Every winter, for fifty years.
He just hadn't known how to ask anyone since she passed.
Then he looked at my snowblower and said, same time tomorrow?
Now there's a second coffee waiting on his porch every morning.
